name: TextStyleCssText
description: CSS text processing on the parent TextStylePaint. Applies only to text owned by a CSS box; source strings stay unchanged.

textTransform.description: CSS text-transform: 0 none, 1 uppercase, 2 lowercase, 3 capitalize. Uses Unicode default case mapping without language tailoring.

whiteSpace.description: CSS white-space: 0 normal, 1 pre, 2 pre-wrap, 3 pre-line, 4 nowrap. Controls collapsing only; Text.wrap controls wrapping.
